settings.diagnostics.blancKeepsALocal.message: Blanc keeps a local, 50-event crash ledger with timestamps, process type, and failure reason. It never includes URLs, page titles, history, profile names, account data, identifiers, quiet-tab state, or closed-tab state, and nothing is sent automatically.

settings.patron.blancPatronUnlocksBlanc.message: Blanc Patron unlocks Blanc Spaces on every platform. A one-time founding license activates once, with no further contact. A monthly or annual subscription checks in with Polar about once a day — your license key and activation id only, never browsing data — to confirm it’s still active. On a lapse, existing spaces stay available while creating new ones pauses.

settings.help.blancConnectsToWebsites.message: Blanc connects to websites you open and GitHub for app updates. Searches and enabled suggestions go to your selected search provider; DNS lookups use your system or selected DNS provider. Selecting Google sends searches and eligible suggestion prefixes to Google.
